messages: Krampus consulted the ledger for {date}. {count} putter(s) never showed for {round}: {users}. The birch rod records **{penalty}** against each of them.

{users} — absent for {round}. Krampus does not forget an empty scorecard. **{penalty}**, and the chains rattle closer.

perfectDayMessages: Every putter answered the bell for {round}. Krampus is denied a single victim today. Disappointing.
Round {round}: a full field. No absences, no penalties. Krampus sulks by the fire.
